name: HEY
tagline: Opinionated paid email service with screening, bundles, and privacy defaults

pricing.notes: Official pricing checked 2026-07-30; 4+ character personal address is $99/year, equivalent to $8.25/month.

verdictSummary: You can build an email client, but replacing HEY means running a trustworthy email service: deliverability, spam filtering, abuse handling, storage, mobile apps, and reputation.
coreLoopDIY: Build a personal mail client on top of IMAP/SMTP or a hosted mailbox; do not try to replace the global email service layer casually.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because email is infrastructure; deliverability and trust are the product.

priorArt.name: Mail-in-a-Box
priorArt.desc: Open-source personal mail server stack; useful prior art but deliverability remains the mo

notes: Valuable no: the UI is cloneable, but email infrastructure is not an afternoon project.
